mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.parent_id, g.name, g.grade_value, g.unit_label, g.display_order, g.active, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u WHERE u.grade_id = g.id AND u.active = TRUE) AS user_count FROM emp_grades g ORDER BY g.display_order, g.id
SELECT g.id, g.parent_id, g.name, g.grade_value, g.unit_label, g.display_order, g.active, 0 AS user_count FROM emp_grades g WHERE g.active = TRUE ORDER BY g.display_order, g.id

SELECT g.id, g.parent_id, g.name, g.grade_value, g.unit_label, g.display_order, g.active, 0 AS user_count FROM emp_grades g WHERE g.name = #{name} ORDER BY g.parent_id IS NOT NULL, g.display_order, g.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp_grades(parent_id, name, grade_value, unit_label, display_order, active) VALUES(#{parentId}, #{name}, #{gradeValue}, #{unitLabel}, #{displayOrder}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp_grades SET parent_id = #{parentId}, name = #{name}, grade_value = #{gradeValue}, unit_label = #{unitLabel}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE emp_grades SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE emp_grades SET display_order = #{displayOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT depth, unit_label FROM grade_depth_units ORDER BY depth
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grade_depth_units(depth, unit_label, updated_by) VALUES(#{depth}, #{unitLabel}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE unit_label = VALUES(unit_label), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE grade_id = #{gradeId}
SELECT g.name FROM users u JOIN emp_grades g ON g.id = u.grade_id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT t.leader_user_id FROM teams t WHERE t.leader_user_id IS NOT NULL AND t.active = TRUE AND t.node_type IN ('TEAM', 'DIVISION')
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET grade_id = #{gradeId} WHERE id = #{userId}
